mapper.sql: select t.id, t.user_id, t.category_id, c.name as category_name, t.amount, t.type, t.transaction_time, t.note, t.image_path, t.location, t.sync_state, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from fin_transactions t left join fin_categories c on t.category_id = c.id
mapper.select: where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.transaction_time desc
where t.category_id = #{categoryId} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.transaction_time desc

select DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(transaction_time/1000), '%c') as month, sum(case when type = 1 then amount else 0 end) as expense, sum(case when type = 2 then amount else 0 end) as income from fin_transactions where user_id = #{userId} and DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(transaction_time/1000), '%Y') = #{year} and del_flag = '0' group by month order by month

select c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, sum(t.amount) as amount, count(t.id) as count from fin_transactions t left join fin_categories c on t.category_id = c.id where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.transaction_time >= #{startTime} and t.transaction_time <= #{endTime} and t.type = #{type} and t.del_flag = '0' group by c.id, c.name order by amount desc

select c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, sum(t.amount) as amount, count(t.id) as count from fin_transactions t left join fin_categories c on t.category_id = c.id where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.transaction_time >= #{startTime} and t.transaction_time <= #{endTime} and t.type = #{type} and t.del_flag = '0' group by c.id, c.name order by amount desc

select DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(transaction_time/1000), '%Y-%m') as month, sum(case when type = 1 then amount else 0 end) as expense, sum(case when type = 2 then amount else 0 end) as income from fin_transactions where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' and transaction_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) group by month order by month
mapper.insert: insert into fin_transactions ( user_id, category_id, amount, type, transaction_time, note, image_path, location, sync_state, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{transactionTime}, #{note}, #{imagePath}, #{location}, #{syncState}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update fin_transactions set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}
